decks.notes: The deck is focused on assembling a powerful combo that involves using cards like Brain Freeze, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Ill-Gotten Gains to quickly mill your opponent's library. It includes various ways to tutor for the key pieces of the combo and protect yourself while setting up. The mana base is optimized to support the combo and ensure consistent performance. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through a quick and efficient combo sequence that overwhelms the opponent's resources.

This deck focuses on utilizing elves to quickly ramp up mana production and overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Fyndhorn Elves, Llanowar Elves, and Priest of Titania, the deck aims to generate large amounts of mana to play powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. The deck also includes cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to provide additional utility and efficiency. Survival of the Fittest is used to search for key creatures, while Gaea's Cradle fuels the deck's mana production. The goal is to quickly build a strong board presence and overrun the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing lands such as Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave to generate threats and win conditions. Standstill is used to generate card advantage while keeping the opponent from playing spells, and Decree of Justice can create a swarm of flying tokens to close out the game. Parallax Tide provides additional control by temporarily removing lands from the opponent's side of the battlefield. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of control elements and efficient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Terravore and Call of the Herd, alongside disruptive spells like Meddling Mage and Armageddon, to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With ramp from Weathered Wayfarer and Mox Diamond, the deck aims to establish a powerful board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Sylvan Library and Swords to Plowshares provides additional versatility and control options. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's resources and play a fast-paced, aggressive game to secure victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board state with discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, as well as creature removal like Smother and Snuff Out. It also utilizes a graveyard strategy with cards like Phyrexian Furnace and Skeletal Scrying. The deck aims to control the game through card advantage and disruption while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Ravenous Rats and Call of the Herd. The mana base provides a good balance of colored mana sources to support the deck's versatile spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with direct damage spells in order to quickly deplete the opponent's hand size and life total. By utilizing cards like Hypnotic Specter and Ravenous Rats to force discard, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal damage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of The Rack and Cursed Scroll provide additional ways to chip away at the opponent's life total, making it difficult for them to mount a defense.

The main focus of this deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence by playing low-cost creatures such as Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to keep the pressure on the opponent. The goal is to deal as much direct damage as possible and finish off the opponent quickly with cards like Ball Lightning and Fireblast. Additionally, cards like Sulfuric Vortex provide a constant source of damage over time, ensuring a steady stream of pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using creatures with the Madness ability to cast powerful spells at a reduced cost. By using cards like Tireless Tribe and Wild Mongrel to enable Madness, the deck can efficiently control the opponent's plays while quickly building up a threatening board presence. The inclusion of powerful spells like Swords to Plowshares and Roar of the Wurm further solidify the deck's aggressive strategy, allowing for quick wins through a combination of creature damage and direct spell damage.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent using efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The deck includes a mix of early game disruption like Duress and Ravenous Rats, along with efficient beaters like Nantuko Shade and Hypnotic Specter. The deck also includes some resource denial with cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategy through counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells while utilizing Psychatog as a win condition. It also includes card draw and resource management cards to ensure consistency and card advantage. The deck aims to control the game by answering threats and outvaluing the opponent's cards, eventually overwhelming them with a large Psychatog to finish the game. It is a versatile strategy that can adapt to different matchups and requires careful decision-making and resource management skills to pilot effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through card advantage and disruption while building up the power of Psychatog. By using a combination of counter spells, hand disruption, and card draw, the deck aims to protect Psychatog and allow it to grow in power quickly. With access to efficient removal spells and permission, the deck can maintain control of the game and grind out advantages over the opponent, ultimately setting up for a powerful finish with Psychatog.

This deck is focused on playing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck includes efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. Cursed Scroll provides additional direct damage, while Sulfuric Vortex ensures a steady stream of damage. The mana base is streamlined to maximize the consistency of casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, direct damage before they can stabilize.

The deck revolves around utilizing Stasis to lock down opponent's resources and win through combo cards like Brain Freeze and Gush. It uses disruptive spells like Counterspell and Daze to protect its combo pieces and control the game. Black Vise is used as a win condition while cards like Chain of Vapor and Forsaken City provide additional utility. The deck aims to create a lock on the game while setting up a winning combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo while using control elements like Counterspell and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to draw cards rapidly with spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Impulse, while also protecting the combo pieces with cards like Foil and Duress. The deck also includes some removal options like Smother and Chain of Vapor to deal with threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and fetching needed colors for spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on using powerful creatures and enchantments to control the game while using Survival of the Fittest to search for specific creatures. The deck aims to generate mana quickly through cards like Birds of Paradise and Llanowar Elves in order to cast big threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. It also includes utility creatures like Nantuko Vigilante and Wirewood Symbiote to deal with various threats. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by constantly generating card advantage and overwhelming them with powerful creature plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore to quickly pressure opponents while also disrupting their mana base with cards like Wasteland and Armageddon. The deck also includes ways to replenish resources with Sylvan Library and efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. Mana acceleration from Mox Diamond and fixing from Weathered Wayfarer allow for a smooth curve to deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression and mana disruption to secure a victory.
